+title: 'Bind the session picker to ConnectionModel: sessions, load more, delete, close, capability flags'
+---
+## What
+Source: update.md §4.3 (session list, close, delete, capability flags), §4.7 ("Session picker", "Capabilities"), §8 item 2.
+
+- [ ] `SessionListView` and `SessionListModel` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/Sessions/`) read `ConnectionModel.sessions` (ACP `SessionInfo`). Remove the kit `SessionSummary`. Show "Load more" when `hasMoreSessions` is true; it calls `loadMoreSessions()`. Refresh calls `refreshSessions(cwd:)`.
+- [ ] A delete action calls `deleteSession(_:)`. Hide it when `canDeleteSessions` is false. Hide the list when `canListSessions` is false. Hide resume when `canResumeSessions` is false.
+- [ ] When a thread view closes, call `ConnectionModel.close(_:)` (when `canCloseSessions` is true). At present nobody sends `session/close`.
+- [ ] A selected session resumes with `replayFrom: .start`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Two pages of sessions show after one "Load more".
+- [ ] With `canDeleteSessions` false, no delete control shows.
+- [ ] Close of a thread sends `session/close`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Sessions/SessionPickerConnectionModelHostedTests.swift`: paging, delete, the hidden controls for each false flag, close on thread close. Assert on the frames of the scripted agent.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
